facts.fact: TESPOK says the Kenya Internet Exchange Point (KIXP) is located at 4 data centres in Kenya with 120 members connected, 1.994 Tb/s connected capacity and 60% of peers on IPv6.
TESPOK lists Google, Akamai, Meta (Facebook), Amazon, Netflix, Microsoft and Huawei among the international content delivery networks that are members of KIXP.
TESPOK lists networks from other countries as KIXP members, including BSC-Rwanda, Roke Telkom-Uganda, China Telecom, Hurricane Electric and BICS.
